definitions.explanation: Agreeing immediately without hesitation, as if answering 'yes, yes' (saying はい twice). Used to describe enthusiastic or unhesitating acceptance of a request or proposal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二|ふた}つ{返事|へんじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}けた→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧。
⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誘|さそ}ったら→誘う：01947_sasou⟧、{二|ふた}つ{返事|へんじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧OK⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: When I invited her on a trip, she immediately said yes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦アップ→アップ：00005_appu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、{二|ふた}つ{返事|へんじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: After hearing about the salary increase, he decided to change jobs without a second thought.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the pattern {二|ふた}つ{返事|へんじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (with ready consent). The expression comes from the idea of answering 'はい、はい' (yes, yes) — responding so quickly that you say yes twice. Always implies a positive, willing response.
Despite ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧ meaning 'two,' this expression is positive. In everyday speech, saying はい twice (⟦はいはい→はいはい：21484_haihai⟧) can sound dismissive, but {二|ふた}つ{返事|へんじ} as an idiom means enthusiastic agreement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {二|ふた}つ{返事|へんじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧ (to accept readily)
- {二|ふた}つ{返事|へんじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧OK⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to immediately agree)
- {二|ふた}つ{返事|へんじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{承諾|しょうだく}する→承諾する：18993_shoudakusuru⟧ (to consent without hesitation)
